prompt: Inside a gleaming robotics factory, multiple assembly lines hum with activity. A robotic arm sweeps metal chassis along a stainless-steel conveyor belt past a welding torch engaged in spot welds. Circuit boards slide under an inspection camera beside a control panel full of blinking LEDs and touchscreens. A technician in a lab coat adjusts a barcode scanner mounted above a wire spool while a laser cutter carves precise openings in aluminum plates. A hydraulic press compresses components next to a pneumatic cylinder and a coolant tank with visible hoses. Overhead, an overhead crane carries metal frames above an assembly station stocked with sensor modules and a toolbox waiting by a safety barrier. An emergency stop button is mounted on the operator console beside a power cable connector. There is no wooden pallet, no forklift, no office chair, no cardboard box, and no plastic container.
